== Summary ==
Complete earlier and later [[Houjix]] PC source faces, scaled side by side. Sources: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/houjix.gif earlier image] and [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/48d57c17d760f4bb25b4d55459f709eef5f8cb82/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/hires/houjix.png 27 January 2024 image]. The unchanged source files are retained separately. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original images published by the Players Committee.
